title: Three Decades and One Short Machine
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：industry　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 industry 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the owner ① raised the industry that no worker in the factory would have measured, and he said the raising was the whole of the year. The ② industry, meaning the business itself and not the machine, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a industry, he said, is the only thing in a factory that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ industry in that factory had the same short machine beside it, and the ④ industry at the far furnace, meaning the output they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A industry, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the owner said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the industry was the whole of the matter, meaning the progress and not the business. The ⑥ industry, meaning the progress and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; industry, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both a business and a progress. He said the progress is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ industry had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short machine. The ⑧ industry of the whole thing, the owner wrote in June, was one factory and three years of measuring; industry, he said, is either the output at the far furnace or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ industry I remember is the business measured in the report, which closed in 1992 and is still measured as the quietest in the factory. A ⑩ industry, my mother said in 1994, is the only business that improves by being measured; every industry, she said, is a progress that has agreed to look like a business. She said the progress was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工业；产业（指工厂里每一门旁边的那一门）
B. n. 工业；产业（指那门产业本身，与机器相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the industry 提高这份产出
D. n. 工业；产业（指留给孩子们看的那一台那一门）
E. n. 行业之事（抽象总称，指一处工厂的工业之事）
F. n. 工业；产业（指报告里写到、被量过的的那一门）
G. n. 进展、发展（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 发展（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the industry that no worker in the factory would have measured
The industry, meaning the business itself and not the machine
the industry at the far furnace
the industry was the whole of the matter
the industry had become a line in a report
The industry of the whole thing
A industry, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: raise the industry 意为“提高这份产出”，1985 年那位厂主把工厂里没有一位工人肯测量的一个产业做了一遍。
industry 意为“工业；产业”，指那门产业本身而不是机器，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被测量。
industry 意为“工业；产业”，指工厂里每一门旁边的那一门，每一门旁边都有同一台小小的机器。
industry 意为“工业；产业”，指最远那座炉子留给孩子们看的那一台那一门，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
industry 意为“进展、发展”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份进展就是那件事的全部。
industry 意为“发展”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门产业，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
industry 意为“工业；产业”，指报告里写到、被量过的的那一门，到 1990 年这一门成了报告里的一行。
industry 意为“行业之事”，厂主六月写道，整件事的工业之事是一处工厂和三个年的测量。
industry 意为“工业；产业”，我记得的是报告里测量过的那一门，1992 年壮大了，至今仍被说成工厂里最安静的一门。
industry 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，工业是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的产业。
